changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Intersect') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Intersect]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [IntersectTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Subject] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [SubjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_UpdatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [Owner] [varchar](100) NULL, [Deleted] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_Deleted] DEFAULT (0) NULL, [Visible] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_Visible] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [SourceID] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Intersect_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Intersect] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Intersect_IntersectType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Intersect] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Intersect_IntersectType] FOREIGN KEY([IntersectTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[IntersectType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Intersect] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Intersect_IntersectType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_Intersect') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_Intersect] ON [dbo].[Intersect] ( [IntersectTypeID] ASC, [Subject] ASC, [SubjectID] ASC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID] ON [dbo].[Intersect] ( [IntersectTypeID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Intersect_Object_IntersectType_Deleted') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Intersect_Object_IntersectType_Deleted] ON [dbo].[Intersect] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [IntersectTypeID] ASC, [Deleted] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Intersect_Subject_SubjectID_IntersectType') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Intersect_Subject_SubjectID_IntersectType] ON [dbo].[Intersect] ( [SubjectID] ASC, [Subject] ASC ) INCLUDE([IntersectTypeID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Intersect_Uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Intersect_Uid] ON [dbo].[Intersect] ( [uid] ASC ) END
